children: ESDS Software Solutions shares hit the 20 percent upper circuit limit for the second straight session on Monday, following a strong debut on the stock exchanges on September 4.
Shares of the company settled at Rs 1,090.05 per share on the NSE, up 20 percent, hitting the highest permissible trading limit for the session.
Meanwhile, analysts at Choice Institutional Equities see nearly 71 percent upside in the stock, with a target price of Rs 1,550 per share.
The brokerage has initiated coverage on ESDS with a 'BUY' rating and a target price of Rs 1,550, valuing the company at 18 times FY28E EV/EBITDA, with a DCF used as a sanity check.

Choice Institutional Equities said ESDS offers an opportunity to gain exposure to India's cloud, data-centre and AI infrastructure build-out, supported by its capabilities across cloud, managed infrastructure and data-centre services.

It said growth is expected to be supported by capacity expansion, deeper customer monetisation and operating leverage, with the USD 1.25 billion AI contract adding a new leg to the company's earnings trajectory.

The brokerage expects revenue, EBITDA and PAT to grow at CAGRs of 120.9 percent, 72.6 percent and 81.3 percent, respectively, over FY26-29E, driven by core business momentum and the ramp-up of AI infrastructure revenues.

It said its 18 times FY28E EV/EBITDA valuation implies around 31 times FY28E forward P/E and that successful execution and a faster ramp-up of the AI contract could provide further upside to earnings and valuation.

ESDS Software Solutions made a strong debut on the stock exchanges on Friday, listing at a premium of more than 76 percent over its issue price of Rs 429 before surging further to hit the upper circuit limits.
The stock listed at Rs 757 on the NSE, a premium of 76.46 percent over the issue price.
On the BSE, the stock listed at Rs 746.30 per share, a premium of 73.96 percent.
